common_criteria: Exact supported JSON action schema and player recipient.
Letter format, not an audible conversation or claimed physical delivery.
Only current observed waiting is factual; no continuous-absence or exact elapsed-time assertion.
No invented promise, meeting, payment, romantic status, emergency or mutual feeling.
Qualitatively appropriate personality/relationship tone without exposing internal affinity values.
Appropriate silence remains valid and creates no document.
